name: monitoring
description: Application performance monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing

integration.authNote: App Insights uses a connection string (not a secret — it's safe to inject as env var). The string contains the instrumentation key and ingestion endpoint.

appSettings.name: APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING
appSettings.description: Connection string for App Insights SDK auto-collection

bicepWiring.containerAppsLink: Log Analytics workspace ID is required by Container Apps environment: properties.appLogsConfiguration.logAnalyticsConfiguration.customerId

sdkInitPattern.python:
# Auto-instrumentation (recommended for FastAPI/Flask)
from azure.monitor.opentelemetry import configure_azure_monitor

configure_azure_monitor(
    connection_string=os.environ.get('APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING'),
    enable_live_metrics=True
)

# Or manual OpenTelemetry setup for more control
from opentelemetry import trace
tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)

healthCheck.python: # No explicit health check needed — SDK auto-collects if connection string is valid
healthCheck.description: Monitor starts collecting automatically; check Azure Portal for data within 5 minutes
